# Traditional-to-Simplified Chinese dictionaries

`TSCharacters.txt` and `TSPhrases.txt` are unmodified OpenCC dictionaries,
distributed with `opencc-python-reimplemented` 0.1.7. OpenCC is developed by
BYVoid and contributors: https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC.

Distribution source: https://pypi.org/project/opencc-python-reimplemented/0.1.7/

The Apache 2.0 license is included in `LICENSE.txt`.

`scripts/chinese.mjs` uses these dictionaries only when building the website.
No converter or dictionary is downloaded by visitors. Original Traditional
Chinese copy and book-cover artwork are preserved; Simplified Chinese is a
separate text rendering. English text is supplied independently.
